evals.prompt: Crea la experiencia 3D individual del bloque G4ED y déjala lista para Piezas y Repuestos.
evals.expected_output: A component binding with stable nodes, orbit, bounds, hashes and non-OEM authority.
expectations: Ordinal 1 resolves to one GLB group and at least one mesh.
The binding supports ORBIT_360 and finite camera bounds.
The manifest forbids OEM and dimensional claims.

evals.prompt: Haz seleccionable el cilindro número 1 y permite pedirlo como repuesto.
evals.expected_output: A semantic region that is selectable but redirects commerce to the cylinder block.
expectations: Ordinal 2 uses SEMANTIC_REGION and SCHEMATIC_REGION.
The region points to the block parent.
The region cannot be sold independently.

evals.prompt: Anima en 3D las galerías internas de aceite del bloque.
evals.expected_output: A schematic emissive flow path with FLOW_TRACE and source traceability.
expectations: Ordinal 7 uses FLOW_TRACE.
The GLB contains a dedicated ordinal 7 mesh node.
The manifest atlas hash matches the canonical knowledge asset.

evals.prompt: Construye cigüeñal, muñones y contrapesos en 360 sin confundirlos como repuestos separados.
evals.expected_output: A rotating crankshaft component plus three non-sellable semantic regions.
expectations: Ordinals 27 through 30 have unique node bindings.
Ordinals 28 through 30 redirect to ordinal 27.
Explode vectors and neutral transforms are finite and deterministic.

evals.prompt: Genera y verifica todas las 420 experiencias del atlas sin dejar paquetes parciales.
evals.expected_output: Twenty complete system packs with exactly 420 unique, traceable and offline bindings.
expectations: Exactly 20 manifests and 20 GLBs are present.
The manifests contain exactly 420 unique ordinals.
Every GLB hash and atlas content hash verifies.

evals.prompt: Integra el atlas en Piezas, IA y Repuestos sin afirmar compatibilidad exacta.
evals.expected_output: Canonical navigation, cited AI context and a reference showroom that preserves evidence gates.
expectations: Piezas exposes the G4ED atlas and Motor 3D links to it.
AI receives canonical source and authority context.
Repuestos carries the canonical ID and keeps visual match non-exact.

evals.prompt: Convierte transmisión, sistema eléctrico, carrocería y sistemas faltantes en experiencias 3D completas.
evals.expected_output: Four traceable atlases with 5,985 elements in 110 complete GLB packs.
expectations: All four canonical atlas hashes match their manifests.
Exactly 5,985 unique technical bindings exist in 110 packs.
Every GLB byte hash and node binding verifies.

evals.prompt: Evita que la app invente compatibilidad OEM, lados u opciones instaladas.
evals.expected_output: Explicit side, body-style, equipment and VIN/EPC normalization gates.
expectations: Left and right names carry an explicit side.
Hatchback-only parts are not presented as sedan-applicable.
Conditional equipment stays pending and unresolved OEM data stays null.

evals.prompt: Integra los 6.405 elementos en Piezas, Motor 3D, IA, DTC y Repuestos.
evals.expected_output: One canonical closed loop spanning all 130 packs.
expectations: Piezas and Motor 3D expose the multidomain selector.
AI resolves every supported canonical prefix through one repository.
Commerce shows canonical 3D separately from seller evidence.

evals.prompt: Modela suspensión trasera, rutas eléctricas y seguridad sin falsificar autoridad.
evals.expected_output: Domain-aware functional recipes and conservative safety constraints.
expectations: Rear suspension knowledge preserves upper arm, lower arm, assist link and rear strut.
Electrical routes use CURRENT_TRACE and dedicated mesh nodes.
No technical binding claims OEM or dimensional authority.
